verdict.rationale: Thoropass's official MCP server lets the assistant act in the workspace "within limits you set," and the docs tell users to add or remove items (likely scopes) depending on what the agent should be able to do. That points to configurable, least-privilege agent access, but the evidence is thin and never describes a credential-issuance flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing dedicated API keys/tokens for agents, a defined list of scopes and their permissions, revocation/rotation and expiry controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
